title: Legislate a competition regime for the largest digital platforms
action: Introduce a regime under which the minister can designate dominant digital platform services, starting with app marketplaces and ad tech, and set obligations they must meet, enforced by the ACCC.
why: Gatekeeper platforms can favour their own services and set terms that rivals and business users cannot avoid, which general competition law addresses too slowly.

evidence.source: A new digital competition regime: Proposal paper
evidence.quote: It is proposed that the first services to be investigated for designation under the regime would be app marketplace services and ad tech services.

evidence.source: A new digital competition regime: Proposal paper
evidence.quote: the European Union designating relevant app marketplace providers as part of the Digital Markets Act

precedents.what: The Digital Markets Act designates gatekeeper platforms and sets obligations for them (as described in Treasury's proposal).
